name.en-US: The Duty of the Christian Prince

description.la: Tres libri de officio principis christiani (1619): virtutes principis, vitae sanctorum principum Veteris et Novi Testamenti. Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), tomo VIII, ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: Three books on the duty of the Christian prince (1619): the virtues of a ruler and the lives of holy princes of the Old and New Testament. Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74), volume 8, from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: Três livros sobre o dever do príncipe cristão (1619).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
